summary.intent: Get a recommendation on pending decisions (ADR 0026 acceptance, release #291, tsrs packaging, small branch cleanups) and process a subagent's hand-back on the tsrs parity check, with the assistant reporting PR #392 status.
summary.outcome: Assistant gave recommendations on four items (accept ADR 0026 with gated default flip, release 0.10.0 now, defer @tsrs packaging to slice 8, minor branch actions) and summarized the subagent's tsrs parity work (212/212 identical rows, PR #392 draft open, CI just started). Awaiting user answers and CI.

repo: Parity check runs via `pnpm --filter caliper-docgen-oracle construct:parity` or `just test-parity`; it takes about 2s, offline, and needs no corpora.
Parity compares normalized type, typeToString text, flags and intrinsicName per row, with exceptions listed in apps/oracle/construct-suite/parity-allowlist.json (currently `{}`).
tsrs is an exact-pinned devDependency of apps/oracle (0.23.0-ts7.1.0-beta); the lockfile grew by about 85 lines.
construct-capture.ts runs at import time, so the parity code duplicates the capture logic in src/construct-parity.ts instead of importing it.
The release workflow callisto-release.yml is hand-maintained, and 0.10.0 is the first release after the toolchain pin change.
Release 0.10.0 includes breaking changes: removed public methods, schema v5, Rust 1.99 MSRV.
Clean-room verification pattern: detached worktree in /tmp with `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --offline`.
tsrs platform packages are 23-50 MB each, so they should be an optionalDependency only once the checker becomes the default (slice 8).

code.finding: New file with the parity comparison and a duplicated capture; paired with tests/construct-parity.test.ts.

workflow: Mutation testing (ignore text/intrinsicName; fake a text difference) was used to prove the parity gate fails when it should.

Hand-back reports from subagents contain unverified claims, so the assistant restated the caveats (intrinsicName coverage unknown, missing-tsrs skip path untested) instead of presenting results as fully verified.
The permission classifier denied remote branch deletion (`git push origin --delete feat/construct-suite`), so it is left to the user.

friction: The classifier denied deleting the merged remote branch feat/construct-suite.
CI for PR #392 had only just started, so its status was unknown.
The subagent did not check how many rows have a non-null intrinsicName, so error-type coverage is unproven.
The unresolved-import fixture was deleted because it did not compile, so error types may be absent from the suite.
